results.title: Eva Longoria and Eugenio Derbez spotted filming in Chelsea
results.description: Actors Eva Longoria and Eugenio Derbez were spotted in Chelsea, Massachusetts filming for the movie "Marcelo in the Real World.”

results.title: Saudi Film Commission Set to Launch Fourth Edition of Saudi Film Confex 2026
results.description: The fourth edition of Saudi Film Confex 2026 will be held on October 28 and 29 at JAX Film Studios in Riyadh under the patronage of Minister of Culture and Chairman of the Board of Directors of the Saudi Film Commission Prince Bader bin Abdullah bin Farhan. Held under the supervision of the Saudi Film Commission and organized by Benchmark, the event will take place under the theme "Industry Shapers' Edition," bringing together film sector leaders, decision-makers, professionals, and industry specialists.
